End Step - Success.description: The provisioning request was accepted and an entitlement refresh was scheduled.

End Step - Failure.description: The access request could not be submitted, so shared-folder provisioning did not start.

End Step - Partial Failure.description: The access request was accepted, but the entitlement-refresh workflow could not be started.

HTTP Request.description: Submits a temporary entitlement request carrying the shared-folder metadata consumed by ConnectorBeforeModify - Create Shared Folder in Active Directory.

HTTP Request 2.description: Starts the child workflow that waits for provisioning and reloads AD group entitlements.
